name: PIR Panel
description: PIR Panel — factory-made polyisocyanurate insulated sandwich panels by SAMAN, manufactured in Bangalore and Greater Noida. 30–150 mm standard thickness (made-to-order to 200 mm), PPGI/PPGL/stainless/aluminium facings, wall and roof applications.
